simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָשֵׁם (H818) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אָשֵׁם (ʼâshêm) means guilty ; hence, presenting a sin-offering First listed occurrence: 2Sam 14 13.

definitions.full: H818. ashem אָשֵׁם adjective guilty , ׳א absolute 2Sam 14:13 ; plural אֶלאָֿחִינוּ אֲשֵׁמִים Gen 42:21 (E); guilty , and so bound to offer a trespass-offering Ezra 10:19 ; but read probably וַאֲשָׁמָם , so Kue Chronol. see h. Perzische Tijdvak, 1890, 43 .
